note: Potential-flow face velocities (m/s) through the coil section. One state. ux (nx+1, ny, nz), uy (nx, ny+1, nz), uz (nx, ny, nz+1), each x fastest. int8, sqrt-companded: v = sign(q) * (q/127)^2 * vmax; -128 marks a wall face (no flow, particles collide). vmax is the 99.5th percentile of face speed (>= 5.5 m/s); the fan-inlet jet above it is clipped.
